pages.text: Set it under open sky. At night a $(item)comparator$() reads the moon's phase off it: 1 at full moon, 5 at new moon.

Use it to see the phase by name.$(br2)The signal is weakest at full moon and grows toward new moon, so a comparator set to subtract can pick out one phase. Some kiln recipes count down only on full-moon nights, and this is how to know when to check them.
